fact: The World Bank completion report of 27 June 2023 says 207,763 parcels were registered in the land management information systems of the Direction des Domaines, ADU and ISKAN by 28 November 2022, against a target of 75,000, and lists the TEHLIL land registration system developed by the Finance Ministry in 2014.
title: Implementation Completion and Results Report ICR00006299 (IDA grant IDA-D1030)
